text: Employees receive 20 paid vacation days per year.
Employees must submit vacation requests at least five working days before the planned leave.
Unused vacation days can be carried forward to the next year according to company policy.
Employees receive paid sick leave according to applicable company policy.
Emergency leave should be communicated to the reporting manager as soon as possible.
Employees can claim reimbursement for approved internet expenses used for work.
Internet reimbursement claims must include a valid monthly bill.
Employees can claim approved travel expenses after submitting receipts.
Business meal expenses require receipts and manager approval.
Reimbursement requests are normally processed within ten working days.
Employees may work remotely when their role and manager approval allow it.
Remote employees must remain available during their agreed working hours.
Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a suitable workspace.
Remote employees must use approved company devices and security controls.
Company VPN should be used when accessing restricted internal resources remotely.
Employees must use strong passwords for company systems.
Multi-factor authentication is required for important company applications.
Employees must not share their company passwords with other people.
Security incidents should be reported to the IT security team immediately.
Company laptops should be locked whenever employees leave their workstation.
Eligible employees receive health insurance coverage according to the benefits plan.
Employees can review their health insurance benefits through the employee portal.
The company provides certain wellness benefits to eligible employees.
Employees should contact HR for questions about benefits eligibility.
Benefits may vary depending on employment type and applicable company policy.
Standard working hours are defined by the employee's team and employment agreement.
Employees should communicate planned schedule changes with their manager.
Employees are expected to attend required meetings during working hours.
Flexible working arrangements may be available for eligible teams.
Employees should record working hours when their role requires time tracking.
Production code should be reviewed by at least one other engineer before deployment.
Engineers should write automated tests for important application functionality.
Code changes should be committed using clear and meaningful commit messages.
Critical production changes require appropriate testing before release.
Engineering teams should document important architectural decisions.
Employees may participate in approved professional development programs.
Training expenses may require manager approval before registration.
Employees should complete mandatory security training within the assigned deadline.
Technical training can be requested when it supports the employee's role.
Employees should maintain records of completed professional certifications.
Employees can request approved laptops and accessories required for their role.
Company equipment must be returned when an employee leaves the organization.
Damaged company equipment should be reported to the IT support team.
Employees should not install unauthorized software on company-managed devices.
IT support can assist employees with approved hardware configuration.
Business travel should be approved before tickets and accommodation are booked.
Employees should use approved travel vendors when company policy requires them.
Travel reimbursement requires supporting receipts and business justification.
Employees should submit travel expense reports after completing business travel.
International business travel may require additional approval.
Employees receive salary payments according to the organization's payroll schedule.
Employees should report incorrect salary information to the payroll team.
Tax deductions are applied according to applicable laws and employee declarations.
Employees can access salary documents through the employee portal.
Payroll questions should be directed to the finance or payroll support team.
New employees complete onboarding activities during their first days.
New employees receive access to required systems after completing onboarding steps.
IT provisions approved devices and accounts for new employees.
New employees should complete required policy acknowledgements.
Managers should introduce new employees to their teams and responsibilities.
Employees participate in periodic performance discussions with their managers.
Performance goals should be aligned with team and organizational objectives.
Managers provide feedback about employee performance throughout the year.
Employees can discuss development goals during performance conversations.
Performance review processes may differ between teams and employment levels.
Sensitive company data should only be stored in approved systems.
Access to sensitive data should follow the principle of least privilege.
Production data should not be copied to personal devices.
Data retention should follow company and legal requirements.
Engineers should avoid exposing sensitive information in application logs.
Cloud resources should be created using approved company accounts.
Production cloud resources should have appropriate access controls.
Cloud infrastructure changes should be reviewed before production deployment.
Application secrets should be stored using approved secret management systems.
Cloud monitoring should be enabled for important production services.
Employees should use professional communication when interacting with colleagues.
Important decisions should be documented in the appropriate company channels.
Employees should respond to urgent work communication within reasonable working hours.
Team meetings should have clear agendas when practical.
Employees should keep project stakeholders informed about important blockers.
